ground_energy.bootstrap_assumption: For a normalized cutoff state suppose q0[psi]+gE_nu W_N<=epsilon N^(8/3), where nu=|psi|^2 mu and g>0 is fixed
ground_energy.shell_covariance: Then q0=o(N^4), so K1539 retains Theta(C_N) covariance in the fixed-ratio ultraviolet shell
ground_energy.sign_shell_release: K1541's projection factorization therefore yields E_nu H_N>=eta_g>0 eventually; its order-N2 derivation only used shell covariance plus amplitude error o(C_N), both available here
ground_energy.interaction_contradiction: K1551 gives E_nu W_N>=c_g N^(8/3); choosing epsilon below g c_g contradicts the bootstrap assumption
ground_energy.variational_floor: The cutoff nonlinear Hamiltonian ground energy satisfies E_N>=c_g N^(8/3) for all sufficiently large N
ground_energy.resolvent_consequence: For fixed lambda>=0, ||(H_N+lambda)^(-1)||=O_g(N^(-8/3)); every scalar recentering a_N=o(N^(8/3)) remains coercively divergent and cannot yield a finite nontrivial fixed-representation strong-resolvent limit
ground_energy.scope_guard: The exponent is a lower boundary, not a matching asymptotic: the known vacuum upper scale remains Theta_g(N^4), no compactness or Mosco recovery is proved, and no continuum interacting BRST operator or source-owned GU Hamiltonian follows
